title: Amazon EventBridge Webhook Events to AWS Step Functions and Amazon DynamoDB
description: Receive HMAC-signed webhooks on a URL that Amazon EventBridge hosts and verifies, and store each known event once in Amazon DynamoDB with AWS Step Functions.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An Amazon EventBridge webhook event source gives a third-party provider an HTTPS URL. EventBridge checks the HMAC-SHA256 signature and timestamp of each request with a secret it keeps in AWS Secrets Manager, drops repeats of the same content within 5 minutes, and puts the request body on an EventBridge Custom Event Bus.

A subscriber on the bus starts an AWS Step Functions workflow for each batch of events. For each event, known types are written to Amazon DynamoDB with a condition on the event id, so a later copy is reported as a duplicate and does not overwrite the item. Other types are skipped.
No Amazon API Gateway, function URL or AWS Lambda function is in the template.
